seo.description: It's never too late to sing. Singing, mentorship and performance with dramatic soprano and Vocal Transformation Specialist Julie Bale.

sections.heading: It's never too late to sing.
sections.intro: Discover the voice, confidence and performer that have been waiting to be heard.

sections.statement: Perhaps you've always wanted to sing.
sections.sub: Perhaps you used to, and life got in the way. Perhaps you sing in a choir but would never dream of standing up alone. Perhaps somebody told you, years ago, that you couldn't. Or perhaps you simply wonder whether it's too late. It isn't.

seo.description: Meet Julie Bale, dramatic soprano and Vocal Transformation Specialist, with more than 35 years singing, performing and teaching.

sections.heading: Singing has been part of my life for as long as I can remember.
sections.body: I'm Julie Bale. I'm a dramatic soprano, Vocal Transformation Specialist and Mentor, and I've spent more than 35 years singing, performing, teaching and being fascinated by what happens when somebody finds their voice. And I still absolutely love it.

sections.heading: I'm a singer first
sections.body: I trained as a classical singer and have continued studying and developing my own voice throughout my career. I have a degree in Music and German, a PGCE and a Diploma in Singing from the Royal College of Music. I've performed as a dramatic soprano, conducted choirs, taught singers and worked with performers at all sorts of levels. And I still perform.

sections.heading: Why Diva Energy?
sections.body: For me, Diva Energy is about allowing yourself to step forward. To take your voice seriously. To enjoy being seen and heard. To stop apologising for wanting something. And sometimes just to put on a fabulous dress and sing. I'm very much in favour of that too.

sections.heading: You don't need to call yourself a singer. Not yet, anyway.

seo.description: Several ways to work on your voice with Julie Bale, from a single VIP day to the six-month mentorship.

sections.statement: So, you'd love to sing. Where do you start?
sections.sub: Maybe you've never had a lesson. Maybe you used to sing. Maybe you already sing and want more from your voice. There are several ways to work with me depending on what you want and how much time you'd like to give it. You don't need to choose perfectly. Tell me where you are and I'll help.

seo.description: From First Note to Final Curtain: a six-month private vocal mentorship with Julie Bale.

sections.heading: From First Note to Final Curtain
sections.sub: A six-month private vocal mentorship with Julie Bale.

sections.statement: What if this is the year you finally sing?
sections.sub: You don't need to arrive feeling like a singer. That's what we're going to discover together. No audition. No need to bring an impressive song. We simply start with the voice you have now.

sections.heading: What's included
sections.body: Private 1:1 vocal mentoring. Professional accompanist work. Diva Days. Performance opportunities. A Final Curtain performance. Online resources. The Diva community.

sections.quote: One of my favourite changes is hearing 'Can I actually sing?' become 'What shall I sing next?'

sections.heading: You just need to sing the first note.

seo.description: A whole day devoted to your voice, with a professional accompanist. The VIP Diva Day with Julie Bale.

sections.statement: Imagine having a whole day devoted to your voice.
sections.sub: No rushing. No squeezing everything into an hour. A VIP Diva Day gives us the luxury of time to work on your voice, technique, repertoire and whatever you most want to explore, including a professional accompanist. Lunch is included.

sections.heading: Afterwards
sections.body: You'll leave with a clear 90-day plan based on what we discover, plus 30 days of WhatsApp support.

sections.heading: What's Your Singing Story?
sections.body: Every voice carries a story. I talk to interesting people from all sorts of worlds about the part music and singing have played in their lives. You don't need to be famous, or even think you can sing. You just need an interesting story.

seo.description: Julie Bale, dramatic soprano: performances, concerts, recordings and the Hope Sings Eternal project.

sections.heading: I sing.
sections.body: Before I teach singing or help someone else find their voice, there's something you should know about me. I'm a dramatic soprano, and performing has been part of my life for as long as I can remember. Opera, oratorio, sacred music, big arias, beautiful melodies, and yes, music where the soprano gets to make quite a lot of noise.

Who we are. This website is operated by Julie Bale ("we", "us"). Our contact address is [ADDRESS] and you can reach us at [EMAIL].

What we collect. When you complete an enquiry or sign-up form we collect the information you provide, such as your name, email address and anything you tell us about your singing. We also collect basic technical data (such as anonymised analytics) to understand how the site is used.

How we use it. We use your information to respond to your enquiry, to provide the services you ask for, and, where you have opted in, to send you occasional emails about singing and events. We do not sell your data.

Lawful basis. We process your data on the basis of your consent and, where relevant, our legitimate interest in running the business and responding to enquiries.

Your rights. Under UK GDPR you have the right to access, correct, delete or restrict the use of your personal data, and to withdraw consent at any time. To exercise any of these, contact us at [EMAIL].

Retention. We keep your data only as long as needed for the purposes above, or as required by law.

Changes. We may update this policy from time to time; the latest version will always be on this page.
